Verified on current bytes: tests/css.mjs areaRows matches only /"([^"]*)"/g, so a correct grid-template-areas written with apostrophe-delimited strings returns [] and Task 5 false-fails. CSS Syntax Level 3 treats U+0022 and U+0027 alike as string delimiters, and the critic reproduced 10 pass / 1 fail with only the quote style changed. Low because every taught example uses double quotes, but it is a real false fail on a required task. Accepted; the correction is NOT applied yet (css.mjs is unchanged) and is still pending, queued as the next single correction loop: let areaRows accept either delimiter (or state double quotes in Task 5 Hint 2), add a single-quoted variant to the solved run, and have the SME critic recheck.
